During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the criminal organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], had a '''warehouse''' in the [[old Galactic Market]] area of the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], on the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Located in the southwestern corner of the Market, the warehouse consisted of an entryway with two rooms branching off, and a secure vault with a [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]] was accessible from one of the rooms.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|thief]] [[Vistis Garn]] and several Guild members brought a shipment of weapons and munitions they had [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stolen]] from the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] back to the warehouse. However, a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] tracked the group back to the warehouse and [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|stormed]] the building, defeating the thugs and retrieving the stolen shipment.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Guild warehouse is a class-restricted location, or "story phase," for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class's mission "Stolen Secrets" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />
